description: Turn a start photo — and optionally an end photo — into a video. With an end photo the camera travels from the first photo and lands exactly on the second (e.g. two views of the same kitchen → an orbit around the island). Pick a ready-made camera move or write your own prompt; choose the model, length and sound. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

cameraMove.description: Ready-made camera move used when no prompt is given.

durationSeconds.description: Clip length. kling-v3 takes 3, 5, 8, 10 or 15; kling-2.6 takes 5 or 10.

endImageUrl.description: Optional end frame — the camera travels from the start photo and lands exactly on this one. Best when both photos show the same space from different spots.

endR2Path.description: R2 path of the end frame — the alternative to endImageUrl.

format.description: Label for the clip's shape; the video follows the start photo's own shape.

imageUrl.description: Start frame — where the video begins. Public https URL or data: URI; either imageUrl or r2Path is required.

model.description: kling-v3: 3/5/8/10/15 s, optional sound, lands most precisely on the end frame. kling-2.6: 5/10 s, silent, cheaper.

prompt.description: Your own description of the video, in any language. Replaces cameraMove when set.

r2Path.description: Storage path of a photo already in the user's Pixly library (from list_library, or returned by an upload ticket) — the alternative to imageUrl.

sound.description: Add ambient sound (kling-v3 only; kling-2.6 is always silent).

name: photo_to_video

status.description: pending | processing | completed | failed — anything not completed/failed is still running

title: Photo to Video
